title: Basis of Acceptance for Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes
content:
A member may hold up to four feed programmes at once, counting every programme that is not closed, because a farm commonly runs different species and different stages on different rations out of different bins. Within the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes one programme covers one ration into one bin, and a second programme is never opened for the same ration and the same bin, since the delivery schedule and the tons delivered would then be recorded twice.

## What the mill requires before a programme is accepted

A programme whose entry gate calls for a veterinary feed directive is not accepted until a current directive from the herd's veterinarian is filed with the mill and recorded against the programme, and the member's assurance that the veterinarian has written one is never enough. A programme whose entry gate calls for a bin is not accepted until the bin is set and its capacity is recorded.

Where the entry gate is not met the enrolment is taken and the programme waits in applied standing, and bagged feed is sold in the meantime.

## The authority the desk works from

The directive requirement is settled on the mill's own records and not on what the member says. What the desk looks at, before the programme is accepted, is whether a current directive stands recorded against the programme, which programme of the Feed and Animal Nutrition Programmes was enrolled in, and the programme number under which the record was opened; the programme number is what ties the directive to the enrolment being accepted.

## Points of judgement

Programmes a member may hold at once: 4, counting every programme that is not closed.

| The member's position | How the count and the uniqueness basis read |
| --- | --- |
| Three programmes open and one closed | Three count, so a fourth may be opened |
| Four programmes open, none closed | The four permitted are held |
| A second programme asked for on the same ration into the same bin as one already held | It is not opened |

*Hypothetical.* A member running a starter ration into the west bin and a finisher ration into the east bin holds two programmes, each covering one ration into one bin. A request to open a third for the finisher ration into the east bin repeats a ration and a bin already covered.
